verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI has no documented built-in AI assistant, but it offers LLM-powered natural-language delegation in narrow forms. The CLI accepts a plain-language query (`-q "Extract all product prices"`) for LLM-driven extraction, and adaptive crawling decides when enough information has been gathered to answer a query. The MCP integration and the downloadable skill package only serve external assistants, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant or agent for delegating multi-step tasks, documentation of conversational or agentic task delegation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
